title: Weekday enum
hints: Store the seven names in an array indexed by the day: `var names = [...]string{"Sunday", "Monday", ...}`. A helper `valid()` that checks `0 <= d && d <= 6` keeps all three methods short.
For an invalid day, format the **underlying int**: `fmt.Sprintf("Weekday(%d)", int(d))`. Using `%v` with `d` would call `d.String()` again, forever. `Short` can slice the full name: `names[d][:3]`.
`Next`: `if !d.valid() { return d }; return (d + 1) % 7`. The modulo wraps Saturday (6) back to Sunday (0).
